contexto: Reconstruccion de The Lurker, iteracion 1, carril MOVIMIENTO (spec .claude/specs/spec_lurker_rebuild.md, seccion 3, puntos 1 a 7). Proyecto Godot 4, GDScript tipado, tabulaciones, comentarios ## breves en ingles que dicen el porque. Cada unidad son sustituciones exactas: el bloque ANTES esta tal cual (una sola vez) en el archivo, con tabulaciones; se cambia por el DESPUES tal cual con la herramienta Edit. Si un ANTES no aparece exacto, para e informa: no adaptes nada por tu cuenta. Las unidades van en serie y en orden (M1 a M7), en el arbol principal, y ninguna ejecuta Godot: lo corre despues el revisor, de una orden en una. Sin commit, stash, reset ni restore de cambios ajenos. Otros dos carriles trabajan a la vez: el del cerebro (lurker_brain.gd, el percepto y el puerto de lurker.gd, difficulty.gd) y el del sonido (mood, aura, voz). En lurker.gd este carril solo toca apply_motion, pick_clip y una linea de show_body (M6). Contratos fijos con los otros carriles, que este carril implementa: (a) motion.pause() -> void frena con rampa sin borrar las piernas, y la siguiente orden al mismo destino sigue sin replanear (order() la reconoce con retarget() o same_goal()); (b) motion.hold() frena con rampa sobre un techo (un tramo de frenada de v2/2a hacia delante) y limpia motion.stuck; toda orden nueva tambien limpia stuck y la pausa; (c) la transformacion cruda (global_transform del cuerpo: colision, sentidos, red) no cambia; el suavizado es solo del nodo Visual (lurker_visual.gd); (d) el vigilante unico de progreso (watch_progress en motion.tick) deja el motivo en motion.stuck = "sin avance", que route_state() da como &"blocked" y el cerebro lee como p.failed. Cifras de la nota: aceleracion 4 m/s2 y frenada 6 m/s2 (tambien en ductos); un plan cada 0,3 s como mucho; vigilante de 0,1 m en 1,5 s (replanea, luego deja fuera la primera puerta de delante y replanea, luego sin avance); a la franja sin parar si va alineada a menos de 0,3 rad; interpolacion entre ticks, giro maximo 6 rad/s, retraso maximo 0,15 m, salto directo con cada jump_id nuevo; idle solo tras 0,15 s por debajo de 0,05 m/s; squeeze de salida ya boca abajo y con las manos en el IK. Se conserva a proposito `stall` (el punto de paso inalcanzable por un borde se da por alcanzado a los 0,25 s): es una regla de geometria, no una espera, y quitarlo convertiria cada caso en 1,5 a 4,5 s de parada. Se conserva `wait_clock` con otro uso (el reloj del vigilante) porque lo lee tools/dev/lurker_route_probe.gd. Ante un superviviente delante sigue parando en seco (body_in_way): no empuja a nadie; el visual suaviza esa parada y el vigilante la saca si dura.

Cambio 1 (order(), same_goal() y retarget()), en game/enemies/lurker/lurker_motion.gd.
ANTES (exacto):
```gdscript
func order(new_goal: Dictionary, pace_: float) -> bool:
	pace = pace_
	if committed():
		deferred = new_goal
		return true
	return replan(new_goal)
```
DESPUES:
```gdscript
## A new order lifts a pause and what blocked her (stuck). The same goal, or
## a new point where her last ceiling leg ends, keeps her legs; a plan within
## REPLAN_GAP of the last waits in `deferred` (spec_lurker_rebuild 3.5).
func order(new_goal: Dictionary, pace_: float) -> bool:
	pace = pace_
	paused = false
	stuck = ""
	if retarget(new_goal) or same_goal(new_goal): return true
	if committed() or replan_gap > 0.0:
		deferred = new_goal
		return true
	return replan(new_goal)

## Whether `wanted` is the goal she is already following (a point within
## SAME_GOAL of it counts).
func same_goal(wanted: Dictionary) -> bool:
	if legs.is_empty() or goal.is_empty() or not deferred.is_empty() or wanted.size() != goal.size(): return false
	for key in wanted:
		if not goal.has(key): return false
		if String(key) == "point":
			if (goal.point as Vector3).distance_to(wanted.point) > SAME_GOAL: return false
		elif goal[key] != wanted[key]: return false
	return true

## A new point in the room her last ceiling leg ends in: that leg moved to
## it, no new plan. Not in a room with columns (her way round them wants a
## plan).
func retarget(wanted: Dictionary) -> bool:
	if legs.is_empty() or not deferred.is_empty() or not wanted.has("point") or not goal.has("point"): return false
	if int(wanted.get("room", -1)) != int(goal.get("room", -2)) or bool(wanted.get("surface", false)) != bool(goal.get("surface", false)): return false
	var last: Dictionary = legs[legs.size() - 1]
	var r := int(wanted.room)
	if String(last.kind) != "tray" or int(last.get("room", -1)) != r or shell.columns_of.has(r): return false
	var p: Vector3 = wanted.point
	var s = shell.tray_state(r, p.x, p.z)
	if s == null: return false
	last["to"] = Vector2(s.u, s.v)
	goal = wanted
	return true
```

func ease_hang(target: float, delta: float) -> void:

DESPUES:
```gdscript
## The one watch on her headway (spec_lurker_rebuild 3.4), in place of the
## old waits: with legs to follow, not paused and not on a leg that ends by
## its own clock, PROGRESS_METRES every PROGRESS_TIME; else a new plan, then
## the first door ahead left out and a new plan, then "sin avance" (the brain
## reads it as failed).
func watch_progress(delta: float) -> void:
	var timed: bool = not legs.is_empty() and String(legs[0].kind) in ["squeeze", "leap", "climb", "turn"]
	if legs.is_empty() or timed or paused:
		progress_from = Vector3.INF
		wait_clock = 0.0
		if legs.is_empty(): progress_level = 0
		return
	var now := anchor()
	if progress_from == Vector3.INF:
		progress_from = now
		wait_clock = 0.0
		return
	if now.distance_to(progress_from) >= PROGRESS_METRES:
		progress_from = now
		wait_clock = 0.0
		progress_level = 0
		return
	wait_clock += delta
	if wait_clock < PROGRESS_TIME: return
	wait_clock = 0.0
	progress_level += 1
	if goal.is_empty():
		# A brake or a climb with no goal to plan for: she stops there.
		clear_legs()
		speed = 0.0
		return
	if progress_level == 2:
		var pairs := remaining_pairs()
		if not pairs.is_empty(): routes.ban(pairs[0], ROUTES.BAN_TIME)
	if progress_level <= 2:
		replan(goal)
		return
	legs = []
	progress_level = 0
	speed = 0.0
	stuck = "sin avance"
	blocked.emit(stuck)

func ease_hang(target: float, delta: float) -> void:
```

DESPUES:
```gdscript
## Plays one of the model's clips (idle, loom, scare, peek...).
func play(clip: String, blend := 0.2) -> void:
	animator.play(clip, blend)


## This tick's transform of the body (lurker.gd apply_motion()) and its count
## of logged jumps.
func present(at: Transform3D, jump: int) -> void:
	var frame := Engine.get_physics_frames()
	if jump != jump_seen or presented_at < 0 or frame - presented_at > 1:
		tick_before = at
		snap = true
	else:
		tick_before = tick_after
	tick_after = at
	jump_seen = jump
	presented_at = frame


## Where this node is drawn this frame, as an offset from the body.
func smooth(delta: float) -> void:
	var frame := Engine.get_process_frames()
	var away := drawn_at < 0 or frame - drawn_at > 1
	drawn_at = frame
	var body := get_parent_node_3d()
	if body == null or presented_at < 0 or Engine.get_physics_frames() - presented_at > 1:
		# Not presented (her capture holds her, a puppet): drawn on the body.
		if smoothing:
			smoothing = false
			transform = Transform3D(Basis.from_scale(scale), Vector3.ZERO)
		return
	var target := tick_before.interpolate_with(tick_after, Engine.get_physics_interpolation_fraction())
	var to_q := target.basis.get_rotation_quaternion()
	if snap or away or not smoothing:
		shown_q = to_q
		shown_origin = target.origin
		lag_velocity = Vector3.ZERO
		snap = false
	else:
		var gap := shown_q.angle_to(to_q)
		var most := TURN_MOST * delta
		shown_q = to_q if gap <= most else shown_q.slerp(to_q, most / gap)
		# A critically damped spring (Game Programming Gems 4, 1.10).
		var omega := 2.0 / LAG_TIME
		var x := omega * delta
		var decay := 1.0 / (1.0 + x + 0.48 * x * x + 0.235 * x * x * x)
		var change := shown_origin - target.origin
		var push := (lag_velocity + change * omega) * delta
		lag_velocity = (lag_velocity - push * omega) * decay
		var off := (change + push) * decay
		if off.length() > LAG_MOST: off = off.normalized() * LAG_MOST
		shown_origin = target.origin + off
	smoothing = true
	var local := body.global_transform.affine_inverse() * Transform3D(Basis(shown_q), shown_origin)
	transform = Transform3D(local.basis.orthonormalized() * Basis.from_scale(scale), local.origin)
```

	var motion = motion_on(m, lvl, 0)
	var target := Vector3(-3.0, 1.0, 0.0)
	motion.go_to(target, 1.35)
	drive(motion, 1.0, func(_mo): return false)
	var cruising: bool = motion.speed > 1.0
	var at_pause: Vector3 = motion.anchor()
	motion.pause()
	drive(motion, 0.05, func(_mo): return false)
	var slowing: bool = motion.speed > 0.3
	drive(motion, 1.5, func(_mo): return false)
	var slid: float = motion.anchor().distance_to(at_pause)
	var kept: bool = not motion.legs.is_empty() and motion.speed < 1e-3 and slid > 0.05 and slid < 0.4
	motion.go_to(target, 1.35)

	drive(motion, 10.0, at_goal)
	check("Movimiento: en pausa frena con rampa, conserva el camino y la misma orden sigue sin replanear", cruising and slowing and kept and no_plan and motion.at_goal(), "%s %s %s %f %s" % [str(cruising), str(slowing), str(kept), slid, str(no_plan)])
	motion.go_to(Vector3(3.0, 1.0, 0.0), 1.35)
	drive(motion, 2.0, func(_mo): return false)

	var fast: bool = motion.speed > 1.0
	motion.hold()
